summary: Enterprise AI model API aggregators let corporations consume foundation models (GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, Mistral, and more) through secure, cloud-native managed endpoints without data leaving their governed environment. In 2026 there is no single winner — AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/Foundry, and Google Vertex AI dominate by adoption, while Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx, Databricks, Oracle, and Cloudflare serve data-gravity and cost-specific niches. The decisive factors are existing cloud contracts, data residency guarantees, model breadth, and how throughput/capacity is metered (a notoriously non-comparable area across clouds).
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and privacy: prompts and outputs stay inside the company's own cloud tenant/VPC rather than being sent to a third-party vendor API, satisfying regulatory and IP-protection requirements.
Compliance and governance: built-in SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, FedRAMP alignment plus audit logging, access policies, and content safety controls that raw vendor APIs often lack.
Single billing and existing cloud contracts: consolidate AI spend onto an existing AWS/Azure/GCP enterprise agreement, committed-spend discounts, and one procurement/invoice relationship.
Unified identity and security: native IAM/Entra ID/RBAC, private networking, KMS-managed encryption, and VPC endpoints integrated with the rest of the enterprise stack.
Model choice and portability: access to multiple vendors' models behind one API so teams can switch or compare models without re-architecting integrations or renegotiating contracts.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service / Azure AI Foundry
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per 1K/1M tokens by model, plus Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved capacity; batch and cached-input discounts available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already on Microsoft/Azure stack wanting first-access to OpenAI frontier models with deep compliance and identity integration.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: On-demand per-token pricing by model, plus Provisioned Throughput for reserved capacity and batch inference discounts.
platforms.best_for: AWS-centric enterprises needing the broadest 30+ model catalog (especially Claude) with strong serverless and agentic tooling.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / per-character by model, plus Generative AI Scale Units (GSUs) for provisioned throughput (e.g., ~25 GSUs of Gemini 2.5 Flash ≈ 67,250 tokens/sec sustained).
key_features: Grounding with Google Search and RAG Engine
platforms.best_for: Data/ML-mature enterprises on GCP wanting Gemini plus a large open model garden and strong MLOps tooling.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Snowflake credits metered per token/function call; no separate model contracts.
key_features: Models run adjacent to governed Snowflake data (no data movement)
platforms.best_for: Organizations with data gravity in Snowflake wanting LLMs applied directly to governed warehouse data without exporting it.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.pricing: Resource Units (RU) consumption pricing plus subscription tiers; deployable on IBM Cloud, on-prem, or hybrid.
key_features: watsonx.governance for risk and model monitoring
platforms.best_for: Regulated industries and hybrid/on-prem environments needing strong governance, agent orchestration, and indemnified enterprise models.

platforms.name: Databricks Mosaic AI / Foundation Model APIs
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based (DBUs) for provisioned/pay-per-token model serving; external model gateway routing supported.
key_features: Models run on governed Lakehouse data with Unity Catalog
AI Gateway for unified routing and rate limits
platforms.best_for: Data-engineering and ML teams on the Lakehouse wanting to build, fine-tune, and govern custom models alongside third-party APIs.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
available_models: OpenAI (via Azure interconnect / Oracle Database AI)
platforms.pricing: Per-character / per-token on-demand plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved capacity.
key_features: Dedicated AI clusters for isolated capacity
Integration with Oracle Database 23ai and Fusion Apps
platforms.best_for: Oracle Database and Fusion ERP/HCM customers wanting generative AI close to Oracle transactional data and sovereign cloud regions.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed in 'Neurons' (compute units) on-demand; generous free tier and low per-request edge pricing.
key_features: Serverless GPU inference at the global edge (low latency)
AI Gateway for caching, rate limiting, and multi-provider routing
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing low-latency, cost-efficient edge inference and a lightweight gateway in front of multiple model providers.
